scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix back" "sleep 3 && npm run dev --prefix front"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix front && npm run build --prefix back
scripts.deploy: git pull && npm install && npm run update:boundaries && npm run generate:municipis && docker compose up -d --build && docker image prune -f
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:reset && npm run db:seed && npm run db:import-osm
